target.statement: Chauvenet-type boxplot with n=31 yields fence coefficient k=1.28 and upper fence Q3+1.28*IQR=2.67%, flagging Qinghai (2.7%) as an additional borderline outlier beyond Tianjin, Beijing, Shanghai, Jilin
target.dataset: Gaokao 2024 provincial 985 admission rates (31 provinces, Table 1)

compute.basis: Install two small CRAN R packages and run a handful of boxplot calls on a 31-row table; the only real work is transcribing the 31 admission rates from Table 1.

blockers: Admission-rate data must be transcribed from Table 1 (source website gk100.com may be unavailable), though the values are printed in the paper
Repo link is a personal GitHub account; exact analysis script may not be present
title: ChauBoxplot and AdaptiveBoxplot: Two R packages for boxplot-based outlier detection
